title: Partner feedback log — AWS Marketplace + GCP Cloud Marketplace (Listing refresh)
body:
Context
- Purpose: single running log of feedback from AWS Marketplace + GCP Cloud Marketplace partner teams/reviewers during listing refresh.
- Owner conventions:
  - PMM/listing copy: Soojin Lee
  - Security wording/evidence: Marcus Lin / Olga Petrov / Dr. Aisha Rahman
  - Provisioning/entitlements: Ethan Park / Chloe Martin
  - Docs updates: Elliot Price
  - Pricing/fees: Laura Bennett
- Status values: Open | In progress | Submitted | Resolved | Blocked | Won’t do

Table columns
Date | Cloud | Channel | Partner contact (external) | Feedback / requested change | Redwood owner | Priority | Status | Notes / link | Target submit date

AWS Marketplace feedback (SaaS Contract listing)
1) 2025-01-27 | AWS | Call (Fireflies ff-9031) | AWS Partner Manager (AM) | Replace “SOC 2 certified” language with “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA” and avoid implying AWS endorsement. | Olga Petrov | P0 | Resolved | Updated copy blocks + security FAQ wording; confirmed with Aisha. See gmail/aisha_rahman/thread-5c21aa10. | 2025-01-30
2) 2025-01-27 | AWS | Call (ff-9031) | AWS PM | Add explicit shared responsibility statement: Redwood app controls vs customer IAM/networking (for Private/VPC). | Marcus Lin | P0 | In progress | Drafted in security FAQ + packet; needs final review for accuracy on VPC/on-prem. | 2025-02-03
3) 2025-01-28 | AWS | Email | AWS Marketplace Ops | Listing long description exceeds character limit; tighten sections and move detailed FAQ to an external URL. | Soojin Lee | P1 | Resolved | Reduced long description; added docs link for “Marketplace buying FAQ” (pending publish). | 2025-01-29
4) 2025-01-28 | AWS | Email | AWS Marketplace Ops | Provide support contact details in required fields (support email + hours) and escalation path for entitlement activation delays. | Dev Patel | P0 | Resolved | Added support@ + 24x5 baseline + “P1 within 1 hour for Premium SLA” disclaimer. Internal escalation: SRE on-call. | 2025-01-30
5) 2025-01-29 | AWS | Slack (Partners thread-1738255601) | AWS PM | Keywords/categories: remove “GPU hosting” keyword (misleading) and add “LLM inference”, “GenAI”, “Enterprise procurement”. | Camila Reyes | P2 | Resolved | Updated keyword set + categories. | 2025-01-30
6) 2025-01-30 | AWS | Partner portal comment | AWS Reviewer | Security attachment: add diagram showing encryption in transit + at rest, and where KMS is used; avoid claiming “customer-managed keys” unless true for each deployment mode. | Marcus Lin | P0 | In progress | Packet draft updated with KMS language split by deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private). Needs final diagram export/redaction. | 2025-02-06
7) 2025-01-30 | AWS | Email | AWS Marketplace Ops | Provide Privacy Policy + Data Processing Addendum links in listing “Legal” section; ensure URLs are publicly accessible. | Michael Grant | P0 | Blocked | Legal reviewing which pages can be public vs gated. Need final URLs from legal site. | 2025-02-05
8) 2025-01-31 | AWS | Partner portal comment | AWS Reviewer | Clarify refund/cancellation language: AWS requires consistent cancellation policy wording; avoid “refunds available” unless handled through AWS billing. | Laura Bennett | P0 | Resolved | Updated FAQ to “cancellations handled via AWS; refunds per AWS policy; contact support for disputes”. | 2025-02-03
9) 2025-01-31 | AWS | Partner portal comment | AWS Reviewer | Pricing section: ensure SKU names match product and console naming; remove “Enterprise” as a plan name (conflicts with AWS conventions). | Nikhil Sharma | P0 | In progress | Aligning with ADR naming + internal billing names; pending final SKU list sign-off (PM-873). | 2025-02-07
10) 2025-02-03 | AWS | Email | AWS Marketplace Ops | Screenshots must not contain customer names, real tokens, or account IDs; add redaction and consistent UI state (org linking success). | Kira Thompson | P1 | In progress | Screenshot inventory updated; design team prepping clean environment. See marketplace-screenshot-inventory doc. | 2025-02-10
11) 2025-02-04 | AWS | Partner portal comment | AWS Reviewer | Add “Regions supported” list and make it consistent with service availability; avoid promising “global” without enumerating. | Mina Haddad | P0 | In progress | Draft region list for Hosted + Dedicated; Private is “customer environment”. Needs final approved wording for EU data residency. | 2025-02-11
12) 2025-02-04 | AWS | Slack (thread-1738890002) | AWS PM | Confirm entitlement activation SLA expectations; reviewer flagged prior listings with delayed provisioning. Provide technical note on webhook retries/idempotency. | Ethan Park | P0 | In progress | Engineering added lag metrics + retry behavior; need short external-facing explanation for listing FAQ. See ENG-4401/4402 + PR-18490. | 2025-02-12
13) 2025-02-05 | AWS | Email | AWS Marketplace Ops | Add product logo in required dimensions and ensure background meets guidelines. | Camila Reyes | P2 | Resolved | Uploaded updated logo asset + verified in preview. | 2025-02-06
14) 2025-02-06 | AWS | Partner portal comment | AWS Reviewer | Remove “HIPAA compliant” claim; can say “supports HIPAA-eligible workloads in Private deployment with BAA via direct contract” only if contractually true. | Dr. Aisha Rahman | P0 | Resolved | Removed HIPAA mention from marketplace listing; added careful “regulated workloads” language; updated do/don’t list. | 2025-02-07
15) 2025-02-07 | AWS | Call notes | AWS Reviewer | Add explicit data retention statement for Hosted API logs; include retention add-on as a separate SKU or clearly describe add-on behavior. | Naomi Feldman | P0 | In progress | Coordinating with packaging: retention controls as add-on; docs in progress. Need final default retention numbers to publish. | 2025-02-14
16) 2025-02-10 | AWS | Email | AWS Marketplace Ops | AWS requires “Fulfillment URL” behavior: on subscribe, customer must be directed to a landing page explaining org linking steps. | Chloe Martin | P0 | In progress | Console onboarding wizard copy drafted; landing page in docs repo pending publish. See ENG-4403 + docs PR-4821. | 2025-02-17
17) 2025-02-11 | AWS | Partner portal comment | AWS Reviewer | Provide minimal “How to get started” steps (3–6 bullets) and ensure they do not require contacting sales. | Soojin Lee | P1 | Resolved | Added quickstart bullets + self-serve path; sales contact optional. | 2025-02-12
18) 2025-02-12 | AWS | Partner portal comment | AWS Reviewer | Confirm incident response statement: provide security contact email and acknowledge vulnerability disclosure intake. | Marcus Lin | P1 | Resolved | Added security@ contact and VDP link placeholder; legal to confirm final VDP URL. | 2025-02-14
19) 2025-02-14 | AWS | Slack (thread-1739153300) | AWS PM (via Partnerships) | Reviewer concerned about observed entitlement delays in staging; ask for remediation plan and monitoring proof before approval. | Rafael Mendes | P0 | In progress | SRE dashboards/alerts added; preparing summary + screenshots of dashboards for reviewer (no internal URLs). See ENG-4407 + observability-pack PR-610. | 2025-02-19
20) 2025-02-18 | AWS | Email | AWS Marketplace Ops | Add “Metering dimensions” clarification for usage-based Hosted API SKU (tokens/requests) in the pricing description to reduce invoice confusion. | Nadia Rahman | P1 | In progress | Drafting customer-friendly meter language; must match internal billing meters + AWS metering dimensions. | 2025-02-21

GCP Cloud Marketplace feedback (SaaS listing)
1) 2025-01-29 | GCP | Slack (Partners thread-1738420199) | GCP Partner Dev Manager | GCP listing format prefers “Solution details + deployment steps”; restructure copy and include a short “Setup” section. | Elliot Price | P0 | In progress | Draft updated in gcp-marketplace-listing-copy-draft; awaiting final provisioning steps copy. | 2025-02-04
2) 2025-01-30 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Team | Provide clear explanation of how purchase maps to Redwood org entitlements; include “link org” step and what identifiers are needed. | Ethan Park | P0 | In progress | Aligning with Console wizard + docs; include “Org ID” and “Marketplace purchase ID” guidance. | 2025-02-10
3) 2025-02-03 | GCP | Call (Fireflies ff-9038) | GCP Reviewer | Reduce SKU sprawl; reviewer recommends fewer base SKUs + add-ons where possible; avoid confusing “Dedicated vs Private” without definitions. | Lauren Bishop | P0 | In progress | Packaging follow-up: bundling Dedicated tiers; clarify Private as VPC/on-prem deployment. Needs updated mapping sheet. | 2025-02-12
4) 2025-02-03 | GCP | Call (ff-9038) | GCP Reviewer | Provide explicit list of supported regions and where data is processed for Hosted API; align with residency statements. | Mina Haddad | P0 | In progress | Same as AWS region list; need EU wording review (see lukas_meyer email thread-2c9a1f90). | 2025-02-11
5) 2025-02-04 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Team | Add required policy links: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, Security page; these must be publicly accessible. | Michael Grant | P0 | Blocked | Same blocker as AWS: public URLs. Need final legal site updates. | 2025-02-07
6) 2025-02-05 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Validation | Validation error: “Support documentation URL” must be reachable without auth; 404 observed. | Elliot Price | P0 | Resolved | Fixed docs redirects; added public FAQ landing page placeholder. | 2025-02-06
7) 2025-02-06 | GCP | Partner portal note | GCP Reviewer | Avoid claiming “ISO certified” unless specifying ISO 27001 certification (and only if current). Prefer “aligned with ISO 27001 controls” if not certified. | Olga Petrov | P0 | Resolved | Updated security packet and listing text; confirmed with GRC. | 2025-02-07
8) 2025-02-06 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Team | Add “Data deletion” statement: what happens when customer cancels; time window for deleting customer content and logs. | Naomi Feldman | P0 | In progress | Requires agreed retention/deletion policy numbers and accurate wording for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. | 2025-02-16
9) 2025-02-07 | GCP | Slack (thread-1738977755) | GCP Reviewer | Confusion about whether offering is “SaaS” vs “Managed service in customer project.” Clarify Redwood is SaaS control plane; Private deploy is customer environment (if offered via marketplace, describe separately). | Vivek Kulkarni | P0 | In progress | Drafting clearer taxonomy section; may need to split offerings or adjust language to pass review. | 2025-02-14
10) 2025-02-10 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Validation | Provide test account for reviewer to validate onboarding flow end-to-end (purchase → entitlement → org linking). | Chloe Martin | P0 | In progress | Setting up reviewer sandbox org with pre-seeded entitlements; ensure no production data exposure. | 2025-02-18
11) 2025-02-11 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Team | Listing screenshots: require product UI images showing configuration steps; do not include AWS console UI (GCP prefers product-native UI). | Camila Reyes | P1 | In progress | Adjust screenshot set to Console + docs only; remove cross-cloud imagery. | 2025-02-17
12) 2025-02-12 | GCP | Email | GCP Reviewer | Add FAQ entry on upgrades/downgrades: how to move between Hosted/Dedicated/Private within marketplace; include note on proration/contract terms. | Laura Bennett | P0 | In progress | Depends on PM-876 decision; draft conservative wording: “contact support to coordinate plan change; billing handled via marketplace rules.” | 2025-02-20
13) 2025-02-13 | GCP | Partner portal note | GCP Reviewer | Security: explicitly state whether customer prompts/completions are used for training by default; reviewer requests “no training by default” language if true. | Dr. Aisha Rahman | P0 | In progress | Need confirmed product policy + exact wording; coordinate with PM + Security to avoid over-commitment. | 2025-02-19
14) 2025-02-14 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Team | Add contact for enterprise procurement: generic alias acceptable; must not force contacting sales for activation. | Jordan Blake | P2 | Resolved | Added marketplaces@ alias + note that activation is self-serve; procurement contact optional. | 2025-02-14
15) 2025-02-18 | GCP | Email | GCP Marketplace Validation | Region mismatch scenario flagged in validation (buyer purchases in one region but attempts to provision in another). Provide error messaging and remediation steps. | Ethan Park | P0 | In progress | Engineering adding clearer error + suggested fix; doc update required. See SUP-18461 and ENG-4403. | 2025-02-23

Cross-cloud / general items to track (applies to both)
- Public policy URLs (Privacy/Terms/DPA/VDP) — Owner: Michael Grant — Status: Blocked (waiting legal web updates)
- Final SKU taxonomy + naming consistency (AWS/GCP/Console/Billing) — Owner: Nikhil Sharma — Status: In progress (PM-873)
- Final, approved statements for:
  - SOC 2 Type II availability and scope — Owner: Olga Petrov — Status: In progress
  - Encryption/KMS wording by deployment mode — Owner: Marcus Lin — Status: In progress
  - Data retention/deletion defaults + add-on behavior — Owner: Naomi Feldman — Status: In progress
  - Data residency language (EU) — Owner: Mina Haddad — Status: In progress

Notes / next actions (as of 2025-02-19)
- Schedule: AWS resubmission window targeted 2025-02-21; GCP resubmission targeted 2025-02-26 (dependent on legal URLs + region language).
- Open P0 blockers: public legal URLs, retention/deletion numbers, and confirmed “training/no-training” statement.
- Prep packet for reviewers: sanitized screenshots, security packet PDF, and 1-page onboarding flow summary (no internal system screenshots/URLs).
